content: The longbow has a normal range of 150 feet and a long range of 600 feet. [Source: "Core Rulebook", p.149] Arrows weigh about 0.1 lb each. [Source: "Equipment Guide", p.22] A quiver holds up to 20 arrows. [Source: "Core Rulebook", p.150] The Sharpshooter feat removes disadvantage on long range shots. [Source: "Feats Compendium", p.34]
